stories.headline: Kast launches border security plan with trenches and walls on northern frontier
stories.summary: President José Antonio Kast inaugurated the 'Plan Escudo Fronterizo' (Border Shield Plan) involving construction of trenches, walls up to 5 meters high, and military deployment along Chile's northern borders with Peru and Bolivia to combat illegal immigration and organized crime.

stories.headline: Death of police sergeant sparks national mourning and presidential response
stories.summary: Sergeant Javier Figueroa of Carabineros died after being shot in the head during a police operation in Puerto Varas. President Kast decreed three days of national mourning and attended the funeral, while the investigation continues without arrests.

stories.summary: President Kast unveiled a 'National Reconstruction Plan' featuring corporate tax reduction from 27% to 23%, elimination of inheritance taxes, temporary VAT exemption on housing sales, and other economic stimulus measures totaling $400 billion pesos in investment.
